scoring_justification: Checker recomputes analytical elastic constants and design parameters using the paper's formulas and material constants; scoring is based on error thresholds relative to those recomputed values.

outputs.description: Forward network predictions of elastic constants at test Vf values.
Inverse Vf network predictions compared to true Vf values.
Inverse angle network predictions compared to true fiber orientation angles.

output_contract.notes: All material constants are fixed as given in the paper. The checker recomputes analytic targets and scores using thresholds on maximum errors (forward relative error, inverse absolute errors).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold analytical values for test points of forward, inverse Vf, and angle networks; material constants from paper Table 1 and formulas Eq.4; laminate theory formulas standard.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and Eq.4 for T300/Epoxy properties; laminate theory derived from standard composite mechanics.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Computed in checker's prepare function using pure Python arithmetic with the same constants and formulas; no external data.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values are exact closed-form results from the paper's defining equations and material data; they are the unique target values for each test point.
